player_prompt.intro:
Nang hkum {player_id} dai Wild Tic Tac Toe ra.
Nang shingrai na, nang 'X' htang 'O' dai hta hkrum hta na shangun ai.
Nang manang ai shi three hta hkrum hta hkaw tsang (X htang O) hta na hkum hkaw tsang.
Nang 'X' htang 'O' dai hkrum hta hkaw tsang na manang ai.
Nang shingrai hkaw tsang '[X 4]' dai 'X' hta hkrum hta hkaw tsang ra.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hkum shingrai hkaw tsang. '[X 4]' htang '[O 2]' hkaw tsang na ra
invalid_move.invalid_cell: N jaw ai cell number: {cell}. 0 hte 8 lapran rai ra ai.
invalid_move.already_occupied: N jaw ai shamu shamawt lam. Cell {cell} gaw masha ni nga sai re.

outcome.draw: Dai gaw dang ai hku byin wa sai.
